title: One spoken sentence, made into a draft
description: POST /v1/intents. The machine uses an installed Claude Code or Codex CLI to turn one sentence into an editable session or schedule draft. This route starts nothing.

text.description: What the person said, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

place_id.description: An id from GET /v1/places, or null when no listed project fit.

model.description: haiku, sonnet or opus for Claude; empty when no size was chosen and always empty for Codex.

instructions.description: The editable first message. Empty deliberately means to open the session without typing anything.

question.description: The clarification to show below 0.5 confidence; empty at or above it.

at.description: HH:MM, or empty when no valid time was given.

days.description: [daily], named weekdays in week order, or an empty array when no days were said.
